settings.title: Settings
settings.no_folders: No folders added. Add one, then press F5 or Library → Scan folders.
settings.clear_hint: Removes all games and their covers. Game files on disk are untouched.

{path}
dlg.clear_msg:
ALL games and their covers/screenshots will be removed.
Game files on disk are untouched.
dlg.remove_folder_msg:
{path}

Games stay in the library, the folder just won't be scanned.
dlg.delete_collection_msg: “{name}” will be deleted. Games stay in the library.

missing.title: Moved games
missing.hint: These games' folders are no longer at their old path. Link the found location or pick the folder manually — all game data is kept.
missing.none: All game folders are in place

missing.card_hint: Game folder not found on disk

dlg.remove_missing_title: Remove games with a missing folder?

toast.removed_missing_none: No missing games — all folders are in place
upd.title: Launcher update
upd.latest: You have the latest launcher version
upd.install_msg: The launcher will download the new version, replace its file and restart. Your library and settings are kept.
col.hidden_hint: Its games disappear from the library, search and shelves. Reveal with Ctrl+Shift+H (asks for the PIN if set).
lock.title: pLauncher is locked

hotkey.need_mod: Add Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win
privacy.pin_short: PIN must be at least {n} characters
privacy.covers_hint: Blur covers and screenshots on the home page, in lists and on game pages. Ctrl+H quickly blurs everything (discreet mode).
privacy.pin_hint: The launcher starts locked and shows no games or covers without the PIN. Files on disk are not encrypted.
privacy.panic_hint: A global shortcut that works even when the launcher isn’t focused. Bring the window back with the same shortcut or by starting the launcher again.
privacy.hidden_hint: Mark a collection hidden in its settings or right-click menu. Its games are invisible everywhere until you reveal them. Locking or the panic button hides them again.
view.card_size_hint: Card size (Ctrl+wheel, Ctrl +/−; double-click to reset)
bulk.detect_hint: Auto-detect the launch file for games that don’t have one
bulk.reparse_hint: Re-parse from the primary source (description, cover, screenshots)

bulk.no_sources: The selected games have no source links
bulk.remove_msg: The games will disappear from the library and collections. Files on disk are untouched.
detail.size_hint: Folder size on disk — click to recalculate

settings.sizes_started: Size recalculation started in the background
hk.title: Keyboard shortcuts

sel.mode_hint: Selection mode: clicking a card selects it (also Ctrl+click / Shift+click)

settings.show_hero_hint: The large banner with the last played (or recently added) game above the sections.
ignore.hint: Remove from the launcher and never add this folder on scan again

ignore.empty: The list is empty. Add a folder here or choose “Ignore when scanning” in a game’s menu.
ignore.unignore_hint: Stop ignoring — the folder will be added on the next scan
ignore.added: Folder added to the ignore list
ignore.unignored: Folder is no longer ignored — it will be added on the next scan
